profile.title: Profile
profile.body: How you appear to people in your workspaces.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Changing your email address isn’t available yet.
profile.timezoneHint: Times show in each workspace’s time zone, with yours on hover.
profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, under 2 MB.
profile.timezoneSearch: Search by city, country or offset

password.title: Password
password.body: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
password.signOutOthersHint: Recommended if you think someone else knows your password.
password.noneTitle: You sign in without a password
password.noneBody: You use Google, Microsoft or an email link. Set a password to sign in with it too, and to turn on two-factor authentication.
password.set: Email me a link to set one
password.setSent: Check your inbox for the link. Setting the password signs you out everywhere, so you’ll sign in again with it.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.on: On. Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.off: Off. Add a code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
twoFactor.needsPassword: Set a password first: turning this on and off is confirmed with it.
twoFactor.scanStep: Scan this code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can’t scan it? Enter this key instead:
twoFactor.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.codesStep: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Signing in will need only your password. Enter it to confirm.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your old codes stop working. Enter your password to confirm.

sessions.title: Where you’re signed in
sessions.body: Sign out of devices you don’t recognise.
sessions.revokeDescription: That device will need to sign in again.
sessions.revokeOthersTitle: Sign out of every other device?
sessions.revokeOthersDescription: Only this device stays signed in.
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of every other device.
